manifestations.description: Pain and ineffective chewing surfaces on the denture teeth
Loss of the natural profile of his teeth (affecting comfort for muscles of mastication and TMJ)
Generalized regional gingival inflammation associated with overhangs, open margin and over-contoured crowns and bridges
Loss of confidence in work ability
Inability to resume work because of his dental problems and associated mood disturbance
Low mood, loss of interest and capacity for pleasure, light and broken sleep
Loss of appetite and body weight loss
Feeling of worthlessness or inappropriate guilt, low self-esteem, fatigue or loss of energy
Afraid to talk to people and even refused to look in the mirror

treatments_received: Root canal treatment (initial and redone RCT for multiple teeth)
Cast post and core for nine teeth
Re-established occlusion by adjustment of temporary crowns and bridges
Removal of crown and bridge work for 21 units by Dr Chung
First set of temporary crowns (1 April to 21 June 2008)
Long term adjustable temporary crowns (25 June to 26 July 2008)
Review and re-evaluation for one year by Dr Chung
Psychiatric treatment at Yau Ma Tei Psychiatric Centre and Kwai Chung Psychiatric Hospital (public sector)
Accident & Emergency attendance at Kwong Wah Hospital (2 May 2005)
Private psychiatric treatment with Dr Singer (51 sessions between 31 January 2008 and 1 June 2009)
Ongoing reviews at YMTPC every six weeks (after June 2009)
treatments_future: 21 sets of individual poly-ceramic on titanium crowns (claimed)
Provision for endodontic failure for tooth No. 13
Psychological intervention for two years in the private sector (claimed)
